run_opaque_doctests: run the doctest suite that validates Boost.Python opaque pointer conversion between Python and C++
test_opaque_pointer_conversion: test that opaque pointers from opaque_ext convert correctly between Python and C++ types
test_opaque_null_handling: test that None is converted to a NULL opaque pointer and getnull returns None
test_opaque_type_distinctness: test that distinct opaque pointer types are not convertible to each other
test_opaque_type_rejection: test that integers and strings are rejected with TypeError when passed to opaque pointer functions
